verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack mentions ISO 27001, its current Annex A control set, a Statement of Applicability, or ISO certification-audit artifacts. The generic Frameworks, Controls and Audits API endpoints (List Frameworks, Create Custom Framework, Compare Control Requirements, List Audits) are building blocks that do not show ISO 27001 is supported as a first-class framework. The axis clearly applies to a compliance-automation platform, so the absence of evidence means none.
